newsitem.title: UK: BoE - One dual, one single UK gilt auction in Q3.
newsitem.headline: BoE - One dual, one single UK gilt auction in Q3.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Monday it will hold one dual and one single auction of UK gilt-edged stock in the third quarter of the financial year.
On October 22 and October 24 an existing short stock in a maturity range of 2001 to 2003 will be auctioned as will an existing long stock in the range 2014 to 2016, the Bank said.
On December 4, a new short stock in the maturity range 2001 to 2003 will be auctioned.
Details of the specific stocks and the amounts to be auctioned will be announced at 1430 GMT on Tuesday, October 15, for that month's auctions, and on Wednesday, November 27 for the December tender.
